name: HOSE
description: HOSE is a mixed poker format: four games in fixed rotation — Hold'em, Omaha (or Omaha/8), Seven-Card Stud, and Eight or Better (Stud High-Low). Played as limit; shared-card games use blinds, stud games use antes and a bring-in. USA; used in tournaments and mixed games.

overview.description: HOSE is a mixed poker format: four games in fixed rotation — Hold'em, Omaha (or Omaha/8), Seven-Card Stud, and Eight or Better (Stud High-Low). Played as limit; shared-card games use blinds, stud games use antes and a bring-in. USA; used in tournaments and mixed games.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6

setup.deck:
Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
setup.dealing: Cards per player vary by variant: Hold'em 2 hole, Omaha 4 hole, Stud 2 down and 1 up initially then upcards. Dealing clockwise. One complete round of each game (every player deals once) before rotating.

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)

rules.objective: Win pots in each of the four games in rotation; each complete round (every player deals once) switches to the next game: Hold'em, Omaha, Seven-Card Stud, Eight or Better.
rules.gameplay: Fixed sequence of four poker variants. Hold'em and Omaha use blinds; Seven-Card Stud and Eight or Better use antes and a compulsory bring-in. All played as limit. A complete round of each game is played before rotating to the next. Best hand at showdown wins the pot.
keyRules: Four games in fixed rotation: Hold'em, Omaha, Seven-Card Stud, Eight or Better.
Complete round of each game (every player deals once) before switching.
Limit betting; blinds for Hold'em and Omaha, antes and bring-in for stud games.
Best hand at showdown wins the pot.

strategy.basic: Know all four games; tighten in your weakest variant.
strategy.intermediate: Switch strategy per game; exploit opponents weak in one variant.
strategy.advanced: Table selection; mixed-game edge in weaker variants; plan for Eight or Better low hands.
tips: Fix the exact local variant before play so edge cases are predictable.
Plan two turns ahead: most mistakes come from giving opponents forced value.
Recalculate risk near end-of-hand scoring thresholds.

variations.name: HORSE (5-game)
variations.description: Five-game rotation: adds Razz to HOSE — Hold'em, Omaha/8, Razz, Seven-Card Stud, Eight or Better.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation adds Razz to rotation; engine uses same core rules; overrides can be added when variant-specific params are documented.

variations.name: R.O.E. (3-game)
variations.description: Shorter rotation of three variants (e.g. Razz, Omaha, Eight or Better); cycles faster than HOSE.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation uses three-game rotation only; engine uses same core rules; overrides can be added when variant-specific params are documented.

scoring.description: Pot awarded to the best hand at showdown; in Eight or Better the pot may be split between best high and best qualifying low hand.
scoring.winCondition: Win the pot in the current hand; best hand at showdown wins (or split in Eight or Better between high and low).
